evidence.quote: We propose automatic payments from a $38 million class fund, with $7.6 million in separately paid fees and expenses, subject to court approval.
Fees were discussed from the first proposal, not only after class relief was agreed.
any fees the court does not award would go to the class.

summary: Class counsel proposed fees alongside class relief, before either term was settled. Unawarded fees were to increase the class’s recovery, but the transcript shows no fee-for-fund tradeoff, defense exploitation of fee interests, or misleading declaration.
